changeLog.change: User explicitly authorises full role-based order-to-delivery and exception acceptance, fixes and traceability.10 requirements retained. Current sourcef63bcf2/Ready53xp97 baseline; prior8orders protected. Functional sales/dispatch/inventory labels may map to consolidated manager/finance roles and will be reported truthfully. No physical delivery/provider/device/production acceptance substituted by synthetic tests.

Preflight9labelled accounts confirms canonical owner/manager/finance/driver/technician roles. Existing8orders protected. Four pre-exception checks pass: access, insufficient wallet/tampered quote rollback, abandoned-card cancellation/replay, independent normal simulated credit. QA customer credited₦50,000 via explicit synthetic receipt with self-approval403 and finance-approved replay safety. Catalogue serial-stock mismatch reproduced (local5available vs0eligible; hosted20advertised/noeligible serials); corrected locally without weakening allocation/inspection. Initial HTTP-method/capacity/baseline test-harness assumptions corrected; superseded logs retained.

New synthetic product COD order EG-2026-7BE57634 accepted/prepared by sales and assigned by dispatcher; finance-issued invoice, driver UI acknowledgement/pickup/departure/arrival and labelled proof upload pass. Restricted driver correctly cannot verify/collect cash; owner supervised handover records collected/unverified only. Wrong-role/customer, stale, handover-attestation and wrong-code guards pass; collector self-reconciliation and premature refund rejected. Cash review UI is unreachable after earlier finance redesign; restored as dedicated reconciliation tab with required identity check and collector self-review hidden. Existing eight orders unchanged; gas flow still awaits demo-only safety renewal approval.

User explicitly approved two-hour demo-only renewals for four labelled QA qualifications and existing sandbox meter. Normal product APIs and independent owner verification will be used; no production controls changed. Third defect reproduced under restricted easygas_server role: refund.request inserted then attempted forbidden immutable-source UPDATE. Fixed by atomic INSERT, without widening permissions; focused regression now passes. Fresh gas and remaining exception acceptance continue.
